scientific_integrity: Exact monomial diagonalization and uniform gamma/lattice limit; numerical checks are ancillary and do not replace proof. Originality review is best-knowledge and not a priority guarantee.
scientific_limitations: Exact fixed-parameter asymptotic only for anti-holomorphic coordinate Hankel operators in complex dimension at least two and radial \(e^{-\|z\|^{2m}}\) weights, \(m>1\); no uniform error term or general symbol theorem. Direct 2007 and 2014 historical texts unavailable for complete priority comparison.
title: Exact Weyl constant for coordinate Hankel operators on radial power Fock spaces in several variables
